scan.title: Scan for appliances
scan.description:
Re-reads your account to pick up appliances paired after setup.

⚠️ **This will sign you out of the HolaBrain mobile app.** The cloud allows only one active session per account, so claiming it here ends the app's session and you will have to sign in there again. Everyday monitoring never does this — only this scan does.

claim.title: Add an appliance
claim.description:
These appliances answered on your network and are not on the account yet.

**This works only right after the HolaBrain mobile app has joined the appliance to Wi-Fi but failed to add it.** Outside that window the cloud will not hand the appliance over, and pressing its pairing button does *not* help — it clears the Wi-Fi settings and takes the appliance off the network. In every other case, add the appliance in the mobile app.

Wi-Fi details are optional; fill them in only if the claim is refused. The **BSSID is the MAC address of your router's radio** (like `a4:2b:b0:11:22:33`), *not* the network name.

⚠️ **Claiming will sign you out of the HolaBrain mobile app.**
